description: Enhanced service-error mapping: mapped/unmapped errors carrying string ids, the full-override mapping (code/message/data) under a string id, the exception-message-surfacing variant, and a service error raised through the alias-published name — verifying host-language artifacts never leak.

cases.description: unmapped exception under a string id
mapped exception code under a string id
full override (code/message/data) under a string id
cases.expected_output:
jsonrpc=2.0
id="e3"
outcome=error
error_code=-5678
error_category=custom
error_message=The message
error_data=The data

cases.description: thrown exception message surfaces under a numeric id
cases.expected_output:
jsonrpc=2.0
id=99
outcome=error
error_code=1234
error_category=custom
error_message=exception message
error_data_message=exception message
